items.title: Ray Lopez Interview, 1958-08-30
items.q: The interviewee discusses Henny Brunus only in the context of his brother Georgie's story ('Henny, Henny was a, uh, halibut trombone player. That's what they say.') and does not describe any direct personal interaction or relationship with Henny himself.

ctx.x: The Brunus brothers told me he used to be a good trumpet player. Yeah.
And, uh, now Henny, Henny Brunus was a, uh, Richie Brunus was a good trumpet player.
Yeah, he's still living, doesn't play. No. He's cooked on the boats now.
